concepts.label: Vocal placement and intimacy
concepts.description: Choose apparent distance and foreground/background balance independently of voice register or texture.

links.note: A direct close/dry vocal description.
Adds depth contrast between foreground and ambience; not a synonym for dry.
Mixed-source band/voice balance wording; not independently verified.
Leave instrumental midrange room rather than merely increasing vocal adjectives.

concepts.label: Vocal phrasing and syllable density
concepts.description: Keep phrase length, note-to-syllable relationship and ornamentation separate instead of treating them as equivalent.

links.note: Long phrase shape; does not by itself specify ornamentation.
Short phrase endings, offered as an alternative to sustained phrasing.
Multiple pitches on one syllable; not the same as simply singing a long note.
One-note-per-syllable tendency rather than melismatic ornamentation.
Limits embellishment without forcing all phrases to be short.
Articulation across notes, not a synonym for sustained or melismatic.

concepts.label: Vocal timing and conversational delivery
concepts.description: Separate rhythmic placement from speech-like character and intelligibility.

links.note: Timing relative to the pulse.
A more pushing rhythmic intention.
Delivery character; may coexist with different timing placements.
Intelligibility is an additional choice, not a timing substitute.

concepts.label: Vocal texture
concepts.description: Describe timbre separately from register, emotional intensity and microphone distance.

links.note: A grain-like roughness description.
A breath-rough or darker color; not declared equivalent to grainy.
Legacy catalogue term with related musical meaning but uncertain current tag reliability.
Airflow component rather than necessarily roughness.

concepts.label: Verse-to-chorus arrangement contrast
concepts.description: Assign different instrumental and vocal jobs to sections instead of applying every characteristic globally.

links.note: A deliberately sparse verse scene.
A separate expanded chorus scene; not intended to describe the verse simultaneously.
The overall contrast goal.
A chorus expansion for songs that want multiple voices; unsuitable as an automatic solo-vocal default.
An unverified complete V6 rock example, not proof of the smaller wording effects.

concepts.label: Kick and bass relationship
concepts.description: Choose timing coordination, level interaction and spatial bass behavior as distinct dimensions.

links.note: A level interaction triggered by the kick.
Rhythmic coordination; not equivalent to sidechain processing.
The sound-producing role, independent of its kick interaction.
A spatial intention; does not guarantee a mono-compatibility measurement.

concepts.label: Stereo width and apparent depth
concepts.description: Distinguish left-right spread, near-far distance and low-end placement.

links.note: Stereo movement or width.
Foreground/background distance, not width alone.
Keep the low-end spatial role separate from wide upper elements.

concepts.label: Acoustic drum character
concepts.description: Choose the intended performance, density and room impression without automatically importing a crowd-noise prohibition.

links.note: The V6 recipe deliberately uses the word live for driving drums.
A restrained percussion role rather than necessarily a driving kit.
A specific softer articulation from a mixed-model catalogue.
An alternate room-description phrase, with the source's trigger concern retained.

concepts.label: Hook focus
concepts.description: Choose a clear repeated idea and enough space for it; phrase length is a related choice rather than a guaranteed hook recipe.

links.note: A repeated melodic idea.
A participation-oriented chorus goal.
A short identifying idea placed before an electronic payoff.
A phrase-shape option that can leave space; it is not inherently more memorable.

concepts.label: Avoidance and positive replacement
concepts.description: Keep desired replacements and source exclusions distinct; no automatic negation rule is assumed.

links.note: A method for describing the replacement role, not a literal style command.
The source's explicit uncertainty about avoidance syntax.
A recipe with separate source exclusions; those exclusions remain separate from its style text.

concepts.label: Exploration and controlled refinement
concepts.description: Use model roles to structure an experiment without promising identical reconstruction across models.

links.note: A model-role workflow, not an audible style descriptor.
An unverified v6-wild bridge exercise followed by v6 refinement.

concepts.label: Acoustic room impression
concepts.description: Describe environmental texture and distance separately from a literal live-audience recording.

links.note: Retain breath and room cues.
A woody room-color association, not a measured acoustic property.
A separate near-far arrangement of direct sound and ambience.
Mixed-source room wording with explicit limits on its surrounding trigger claim.
